advice.q: Is this financial advice, or something I can subscribe to?
advice.a: No. Nothing on this site is a trading signal you can act on, and there is no paid subscription or signal-access product. This site documents how a real system is built and validated — the disclaimers throughout are literal, not boilerplate.

strongTier.a: The direction model outputs a continuous prediction; a rolling-percentile decode sorts recent predictions into Strong / Moderate / Weak. Strong means the current prediction sits in the top slice of recent model output — not a guarantee, a rank.

confidenceInterval.q: Why show a confidence interval instead of just a win rate?
confidenceInterval.a: A win rate on a small sample can look identical whether the edge is real or the sample got lucky. The interval is the honest version of the same number — see the Track Record page.

automated.a: Execution is automated within a staged risk framework — position size, leverage, and daily/total loss caps are hard-coded, not discretionary. Scaling to a new capital stage requires clearing pre-defined statistical gates, not "it felt like a good week."

breaks.a: It gets fixed, and the fix is written down — see the Incidents section. Kill switches exist specifically because the system is expected to eventually be wrong in a way nobody anticipated.

incidents.title: What broke, and what changed because of it.
incidents.subtitle: A running log of real failures — kept because the rule that came out of each one is the actual product of the mistake.

facade.title: The same bug, three times
facade.body: A margin-mode toggle silently stopped every live order from going out. Root cause: a method existed at the call site and at the low-level API client, but the facade layer connecting them was never updated — the third time this exact class of bug had shipped. Tests stayed green because the test double auto-created whatever method was called on it.
facade.fix: Replaced the mock with an AST-based structural test that fails if the facade drifts from what the call sites actually need — verified by deleting a method and watching the test catch it.

outlierFold.title: A lift that wasn’t there
outlierFold.body: An ensemble A/B test showed a clean, above-threshold accuracy improvement in aggregate. A five-minute sanity pass — per-fold mean, fraction of folds with positive lift, bootstrap CI — showed the aggregate number was propped up by one or two outlier folds; the median lift was negative.
outlierFold.fix: Any claimed model improvement now has to clear four checks together (aggregate lift, per-fold mean, fraction positive, bootstrap CI excludes zero), not just the headline number.

staleCache.title: A drift that was a stale cache
staleCache.body: A scheduled model-health report showed accuracy quietly degrading month over month — worth a public post about model decay. The underlying cause was a network blip during a nightly data refresh; the report had silently run on 16-day-old cached features instead of failing loudly.
staleCache.fix: Any automated verdict now checks data freshness as part of the verdict itself — stale input forces an explicit "cannot determine" state instead of a plausible-looking PASS or FAIL.

v7.label: V7 signal engine
v7.title: 4h prediction chart
v7.body: The same interactive chart the model renders for itself — confidence heatmap, regime strip, candles with Strong/Moderate direction triangles, and the magnitude panel. Zoom, pan, and hover the crosshair like any live chart.
v7.accumTitle: Cumulative — signal edge / filter tiers / win rate / live
v7.accumNote: Panels 1 and 3 are signal quality — no costs, no stops, no sizing — not trading performance. Panel 2 compares MEAN return per signal because a filter takes fewer trades, and its shaded band is the data the filters were derived on, so it is not evidence. Only panel 4 is real money. Refreshes every 30 minutes.

liquidity.label: Liquidity raids
liquidity.title: Sweep-failure reversal — shadow liquidity map
liquidity.body: Strategy #2 (forward validation in progress) — four liquidity pool types (swing / session / prior-day / prior-week extremes) get swept, then the engine waits for the retest: resting pools, waiting sweeps, entry/exit markers and the cumulative netR curve, all on one interactive chart. Shadow mode — no live money.
liquidity.shadowNote: Forward shadow validation — rules frozen 2026-07-28, 29 symbols recorded hourly; no real capital until Gate F passes (n≥1400 and day-clustered CI low > 0). Variants: A = original (swing pools, no filter); B = four pool types + shallow pierce ≤0.25 ATR (bright marks / column B); C = B + close-back confirmation (1m price path; column C); D = C + high attack volume vs the symbol's own history — the order-flow combination (column D).
liquidity.guideTitle: Plain guide: flags and tracked combos
liquidity.guideFlags: R close-back = price pierced the level then closed back inside within the hour (stops taken, snap back) | V volume = attack-minute volume high vs the symbol's own norm | Q stop-driven = OI down + taker pushing with the break (a stop sweep, not new money) | FAST = attack over within 5 minutes | PA = the V7 model sides with the fade | LIQ = liquidation burst
liquidity.guideCombos: Eight tracked combos (historical stats are an entry ticket, not evidence): R∧V | R∧Q | R∧V∧Q triple-confirm (fattest, ~70% WR) | R∧FAST | R∧FAST∧Q | R alone | PA | V∧LIQ
liquidity.guideNumbers: Reading the numbers: n = occurrences; netR = average gain per trade as a fraction of the stop distance, net of fees. Common core: pierce, take the stops, snap back — the completed-hunt signature. Promotion needs the forward scoreboard (accumulating hourly) plus the October pre-registered validation.

arb.label: Arbitrage (line 4)
arb.title: Two-venue spread — recording
arb.body: The same instrument listed on two young venues drifts apart in price — short the rich side, long the cheap side, direction risk cancels, profit is the convergence. No market prediction; recording only for now, pass criteria frozen before any data was seen.
arb.pageNote: Record-only: a script logs both venues' quotes every minute. After 7 full days a frozen scorer decides whether the line advances. No wallet is touched before it passes.
arb.battlefieldActive: SNDK · Entropy vs Lighter (0 fees both sides)
arb.criteriaTitle: Frozen pass criteria (2026-08-28, written before data)
arb.criteria1: A threshold band with ≥1 bps net of fees exists
arb.criteria3: Both halves of the recording pass independently
arb.criteriaFail: Any miss → the line closes, total cost ≈ zero
